steps.say: 2D shapes are flat. We describe them by their sides, angles and lines of symmetry.

figure.alt: Six quadrilaterals: a square, a rectangle, a rhombus, a parallelogram, a trapezium and a kite.

steps.say: A square has 4 equal sides and 4 right angles. A rhombus also has 4 equal sides, and its angles need not be right angles.
3D shapes are solid. They have faces, edges and vertices.
A triangular prism has 5 faces: 2 triangles and 3 rectangles.

figure.alt: A drawing of a triangular prism.

steps.say: A net is a flat shape that folds up to make a 3D shape. A net of a cube has 6 squares.

figure.alt: A cross-shaped net of 6 squares: a column of 4 with one square on each side of the second square.

steps.say: Some sets of 6 squares do not fold into a cube, because two faces end up on top of each other.

check.prompt: How many edges does a cube have?
hints: An edge is where two faces meet.
Count the edges around the top face first.
check.explanation: A cube has 4 edges on top, 4 on the bottom and 4 going up the sides. That makes 12 edges.

check.prompt: Which shape has exactly one pair of parallel sides?
hints: Picture each shape and look at its opposite sides.
Most of these shapes have two pairs of parallel sides.
check.explanation: A trapezium has exactly one pair of parallel sides.

options.why: A rectangle has two pairs of parallel sides.
A rhombus has two pairs of parallel sides.
A kite has no parallel sides.

check.prompt: Which net folds to make a cube?
hints: Picture folding each net up around one base square.
A row of 4 squares can wrap around the sides of a cube.
check.explanation: The cross shape folds up with one square for each face of the cube.

figure.alt: A net of 6 squares: a column of 4 with one square on each side of the second square.
A net of 6 squares in a block of 2 rows of 3.

options.why: A 2 by 3 block cannot fold into a cube. Two faces would end up on top of each other.

figure.alt: A net of 6 squares: a row of 5 with one square above the first square.

options.why: A row of 5 squares is too long. The ends would overlap when folded.
